noise: A1 and A2 differ by 5.4% wall (24.24 vs 25.56 s), above the 5% threshold; the machine may be shared with other user jobs, so a ~1 s wall difference is within observed noise.
conclusion: Bit-identical outputs in both branch runs. No measurable wall gain on prefix4: branch mean wall is 1.11 s higher than baseline mean (within run-to-run noise, A1/A2 spread 1.32 s), and the targeted composition_evaluation stage summed over 7 proofs moves by only -0.10 s (~1%), far below the 4-6 s estimate. Peak footprint rises ~0.45 GB, plausibly the process-wide twiddle cache. The expansion is not the composition-evaluation bottleneck at this scale; prefix4 contains only 3 truth proofs, so a full-run effect is unmeasured but unlikely to reach the estimate.
